title: Imagined, then made: private generated-footage proof

story.about: An imagined sailing shot becomes generated moving footage and editable Studio material, without recorded footage.
story.whyCare: A creator can begin with an idea even when there is nothing to shoot or upload.
story.hook: A full-size mahogany yacht cuts through real-looking moving water as the voice says One idea. No footage.
story.beginning: Give the actual generated yacht shot enough space for its motion and material details to register.
story.development: Show the exact generated source material in the actual AutoPromote Studio.
story.tension: How did a brief become footage, and can that footage be edited as real source material?
story.payoff: The Studio source reveal supports the spoken origin: This started with a brief. No camera. No footage.
story.ending: The editable cinematic AutoPromote studio ident resolves the creation proof.
story.withheld: The tool identity and creation method until the actual Studio reveal.
